verdicts.note: Carrying increases the chance substantially and is stable across seeds.
The pass to Sami Okoro also shows a meaningful and consistent improvement.

claim: Marchetti’s shot had a 4.5% chance to score, while carrying the ball would have given a 12.1% chance to score (+7.5 points). Passing to Sami Okoro would have given a 9.2% chance to score (+4.7 points), so both alternatives appear better than the shot, with carrying offering the largest increase.
